# Makhuwa (vmw)

[Edit source](../../locales/vmw.json)

Plural rule: `one_other` (categories: one, other)

## Needs review

These parts of the data are uncertain. If you speak the language, please check the
examples below against them and fix [vmw.json](../../locales/vmw.json),
deleting the note from its `review` list once the data is right.

- **`time.clock`** (low confidence): Additive 'hora {h} na <minutes>' using the locale's own hour word (Portuguese loan), conjunction 'na' and half word 'mettenhe'. Tens written 'makhumi mapili/mararu/mancheche/mathanu' to stay consistent with the file's 'khumi' for 10, but standard Emakhuwa 10 is 'muloko' (pl. miloko), so these tens are my weakest guess. Doubts: 'hora' + bare numeral word order; dialect of the existing numerals (ttatthu, ncheche).
